continuities.name: The Conjuring Universe
continuities.description: One shared film continuity: the Conjuring main series, the Annabelle films and the Nun films. The Curse of La Llorona is included with a flag: Wikipedia says it is not an official installment but takes place within the universe.
continuities.quote: The film was produced by James Wan through his Atomic Monster banner and, though not considered an installment in the franchise, takes place within The Conjuring Universe. … Although the film is not an official installment in The Conjuring Universe, it stars Tony Amendola, who reprises his role from Annabelle as Father Perez.

titles.title: The Nun
titles.studio_or_developer: New Line Cinema / Atomic Monster / The Safran Company

units.label: Film
units.release_quote: The Nun was released in the United States on September 7, 2018.

in_universe.quote: In 1952 Romania, two Roman Catholic nuns living at the Saint Cartha's monastery are attacked by an unseen evil force. … During the filming of Annabelle: Creation, Safran revealed that The Nun would chronologically come first in The Conjuring Universe, making it a further prequel to The Conjuring series and Annabelle series.

titles.notes: Production companies not checked line by line against the infobox; distributor Warner Bros. per the article.

titles.title: Annabelle: Creation
titles.studio_or_developer: New Line Cinema / Atomic Monster / The Safran Company

units.label: Film
units.release_quote: Annabelle: Creation premiered at the LA Film Festival on June 19, 2017, and was theatrically released in the United States on August 11, 2017.

in_universe.label: c. 1955 (prologue c. 1943)
in_universe.quote: A dollmaker named Samuel Mullins and his wife, Esther, grieve the loss of their seven-year-old daughter, Annabelle … Twelve years later, the Mullins open their home to provide shelter for Sister Charlotte and six girls … Twelve years later, after becoming involved in devil worship, a grown-up Annabelle returns home and murders her adoptive parents during the night. Their screams awaken their neighbor, Mia Form
in_universe.note: Wikipedia states no year for this film. The epilogue ("twelve years later") is the opening of Annabelle (2014), stated as 1967, so the main story is c. 1955 and the prologue c. 1943 (1967 - 12 - 12). Placed before The Nun II (1956) on that inference only.

links.note: prequel to Annabelle (2014); its epilogue leads into that film

in_universe.quote: In 1956, Father Noiret and his altar boy, Jacques, perform daily chores in their church in Tarascon, France.

units.label: Film

in_universe.quote: In 1967, in Santa Monica, California, a medical student, John Form, presents his expectant wife, Mia, with a rare vintage porcelain doll

links.note: spin-off and prequel to The Conjuring (origin of the doll)

titles.title: Annabelle Comes Home
titles.studio_or_developer: New Line Cinema / Atomic Monster / The Safran Company

units.label: Film
units.release_quote: Annabelle Comes Home was theatrically released in the United States on June 26, 2019, by Warner Bros.

in_universe.label: 1968 – c. 1969
in_universe.quote: Demonologists Ed and Lorraine Warren confiscate the demonic Annabelle doll from nurses Debbie and Camilla. … One year later, the Warrens arrange for Mary Ellen to babysit their daughter, Judy … [The Conjuring:] In 1968, renowned demonologists Ed and Lorraine Warren investigate the Annabelle case, in which friends Debbie and Camilla have a possessed doll. … [Universe article:] Annabelle Comes Home takes place after Annabelle and The Conjuring
in_universe.note: No year in the film article. The opening (doll taken from Debbie and Camilla) is the Annabelle case dated 1968 in The Conjuring article; the main story is "one year later" (c. 1969). The franchise article says it "takes place after Annabelle and The Conjuring", which fits The Conjuring's 1968 prologue but not its 1971 main story. Ordered by the inferred years, before The Conjuring.

links.note: sequel to Annabelle and Annabelle: Creation
opens with the 1968 Annabelle case from The Conjuring's prologue

continuities.name: John Wick
continuities.description: One continuity: the four films, the spin-off film Ballerina and the prequel miniseries The Continental. Only The Continental has a stated period (the 1970s); the films are ordered by stated relative placement.
continuities.quote: Various spin-offs expanded the franchise: the prequel comic book series John Wick: The Book of Rules (2017–2019), the prequel television miniseries The Continental (2023), and the spin-off film Ballerina (2025). … It is a spin-off installment within the John Wick film series, taking place between the events of John Wick: Chapter 3 – Parabellum (2019) and Chapter 4 (2023).

titles.wiki_article: The Continental: From the World of John Wick

units.label: Season 1

in_universe.label: 1970s

continuities.name: The Matrix
continuities.description: The four films plus the tie-ins Wikipedia presents as part of the same story: The Animatrix, Enter the Matrix and The Matrix Online. The Matrix Awakens (tech demo) is excluded: no source calls it canon.
continuities.quote: The video game Enter the Matrix connects the story of the Animatrix short "Final Flight of the Osiris" with the events of Reloaded, while the online video game The Matrix Online was a direct sequel to Revolutions. … This is to say the game itself is the official continuation of the universe, story and characters established in The Matrix series of fictional works including the film trilogy, The Animatrix short films, the Enter the Matrix video game and a series of officially written and produced Matrix comic books.

continuities.name: The Matrix: Path of Neo
continuities.description: Game retelling of the film trilogy with deviations and an alternate ending; kept separate because no source calls it canon.
continuities.quote: Players control the character Neo, participating in scenes from the films. … Some levels imitate the scenes of the films, other extend them, or take entirely different directions. … The Wachowskis also sought to develop an alternate ending to the narrative to contrast with the pessimistic ending of The Matrix Revolutions.

in_universe.quote: In 2148, following the rest of humanity's refusal to share the planet with the machines, the United Nations unleashes an all-out nuclear bombardment against Zero One … Kid's Story takes place during the six-month gap between The Matrix and The Matrix Reloaded … [franchise:] the Animatrix short film The Second Renaissance act as prequels to the films
in_universe.note: Nine shorts spanning the 22nd-century war (2148 stated in The Second Renaissance) to the six-month gap after The Matrix. One unit (direct-to-video anthology film); placed first because its prequel shorts are the earliest material, although some shorts fall after The Matrix.

continuities.name: Mad Max
continuities.description: One loose continuity of the five films, ordered by stated relative timing. Wikipedia says the franchise has no strict chronology and the later two films describe a different collapse from the first three; placing Furiosa and Fury Road after Beyond Thunderdome rests on Miller's "probably".
continuities.quote: Because Mad Max films are generally told as folklore, the Mad Max franchise has historically been less concerned with continuity than most science fiction or fantasy franchises, like Star Wars or Star Trek. At least one critic has suggested that "the franchise’s canon cannot be reconciled in any way — barring the introduction of time travel." … In the timeline of the first three films, the 1979 oil crisis caused by the Iranian Revolution worsened … In the timeline of the later two films (Fury Road and Furiosa), the collapse happened around the 2010s … It is a prequel to Fury Road; Miller said that while the franchise has "no strict chronology," it "probably" takes place after Beyond Thunderdome.

titles.title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
titles.studio_or_developer: Kennedy Miller Mitchell / Village Roadshow Pictures

units.label: Film
units.release_quote: It was released theatrically in Australia on 23 May 2024 and in the United States the following day.

in_universe.label: years before Fury Road, spanning over a decade
in_universe.quote: set years before Fury Road, the film follows her life for over a decade … According to Miller, Furiosa "probably" takes place after Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome (1985), but the Mad Max franchise has "no strict chronology". The first trailer of the film, released on 30 November 2023, stated that Furiosa takes place "45 years after the collapse".
in_universe.note: Prequel to Fury Road is stated; placement after Beyond Thunderdome is only Miller's "probably", and the franchise article puts the later films' collapse "around the 2010s", a different collapse from the first three films. No year set: "45 years after the collapse" plus "around the 2010s" is too loose to derive one.
